player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Rypcord''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in October 2001.
description: A Dark Side Ep1 {ie. Type 2} deck that uses the Tatooine Maul to duel the opponent to death.
cards: posted: [CORRECTION] Change the starting to add a Boonta Eve Podrace
notes: The post describes this as an Episode I-only 'Type 2' deck; it uses only Episode I-era sets (Tatooine, Coruscant and Episode I cards).
Starting cards as posted under 'start [5]': Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Start Your Engines!, Sebulba's Podracer, Watto's Box; these count toward the 60.
The author's correction in the strategy adds Boonta Eve Podrace to the starting cards and cuts Neimoidian Advisor from 3 to 2; this list follows the correction, so the total stays 60.

Posted 'Tatooine Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'Coruscant Maul' dested Darth Maul, Young Apprentice; 'Aura Sing' dested Aurra Sing; 'Podrace Colission' dested Podracer Collision; 'Neimeodian Adviser' dested Neimoidian Advisor.
Sense, Alter and Control are posted without a set and dested as the Dark Coruscant printings, since the deck is built for an Episode I-only format.
